# Parameter experiments and local result sets

<!-- Generated by scripts/core_docs.py; edit the source of truth and regenerate. -->

Parameter experiments freeze the current configuration and save a complete Portfolio for each candidate. Result collections support reopening, filtering, and sorting.

[Usage guide](../guides/optimizer.md) · [Compatibility and internal entries](classification.md)

<a id="openbacktesting-optimizer-experimentresult-query"></a>

### query

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.optimizer.ExperimentResult.query`

```python
openbacktesting.optimizer.ExperimentResult.query(self, *, order_by=(), filters=(), fields=(), limit: int = 100, cursor: str | None = None) -> dict
```

Query scalar values and parameters for successful trials; cursors freeze the commit range, and new queries refresh it.

order_by is a path or (path, asc/desc); filters are (path, operator, value).
Supported operators: eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge/status; escape dots and backslashes in keys with a backslash.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/optimizer/query.py`。


Browse live statuses of all visited trials by page, without complete Portfolios.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/optimizer/query.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-optimizer-execute"></a>

## execute

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.optimizer.execute`

```python
openbacktesting.optimizer.execute(plan_value, executor, path, *, experiment_id=None, constraint=None, cancel=None, on_progress=None)
```

Execute or resume a plan; executor receives title-based requests and returns complete Portfolio dictionaries.

Constraints receive complete wire values; cancel is a no-argument bool callable, and on_progress only consumes notifications.
Only an explicit experiment_id indicates resumption; failed trials are not retried automatically.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/optimizer/runner.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-optimizer-plan-function"></a>

## plan

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.optimizer.plan`

```python
openbacktesting.optimizer.plan(strategy_class, search: collections.abc.Mapping[str, openbacktesting.optimizer.models.Values | openbacktesting.optimizer.models.Range], *, base_inputs=None, execution: collections.abc.Mapping, constraint_id: str | None = None) -> openbacktesting.optimizer.models.Plan
```

Freeze complete current configuration and selected dimensions; the host must explicitly supply execution identity.

Args:
    strategy_class: Loaded strategy class declaring inputs.
    search: Nonempty search domains keyed by unique titles.
    base_inputs: Existing title-based request; None uses declared defaults.
    execution: Normalized code, market-data, configuration, and version identity.
    constraint_id: Optional version digest of a trusted constraint; the function is not serialized.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/optimizer/plan.py`。
